title: PACP x Metal Bundles
description: Retextures the strings from Metal Bundles to fit with the bundle texture from Programmer Art Continuation Project
body:
# PACP x Metal Bundles ![All bundles](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3998ad79e4d80404381269ff4626dd6e50e5b8f1.png)


Retextures the bundle string textures from [Metal Bundles](https://modrinth.com/mod/metal-bundles/versions) using the texture from [Programmer Art Continuation Project](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pacp) as a base for the texture so the string texture is not out of place when using PACP.
